summary: CR-385 Phase 1 QA follow-up on preprod (OWNER_TGK, restaurant #69). Tested cancel flows for the three seeded direct bookings 222/223/224, no-show inline read-only on booking.com row 7, Channel Manager Front Desk Rules read-only defaults, and F/D v2 regression tabs. C-1 (v2 cancel 222 @ 1920), C-2 (v2 cancel 223 @ 1366), C-4 (clean-up), C-5 (No-Show inline both viewports), C-6 (CM defaults), and C-7 (regression: Esc closes expansion, other tabs render, 0 console errors on v2 flows) all PASS. C-3 FAILS with a real BLOCKER on the legacy /pms/arrivals cancel flow: it passes row.bookingId (public string 'MG-69-CF3A95A8-...') as the reservationId to POST /aiosell/local-reservations/{id}/cancel, but the backend expects the integer local-reservation id (e.g. 224). Backend returns HTTP 500 TypeError ('Argument #2 ($id) must be of type int, string given'). BUG-440 (reason dropdown) is verified fixed on the legacy dialog too — the select now lists ['Select reason…','guest cancelled'] and the overlay class is 'fixed inset-0 bg-black/40 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4' as expected. Because C-3 could not be completed on the legacy page, 224 was cancelled via the v2 flow as a clean-up (successful, evidence captured) to leave the sandbox in the intended end-state. Settings/rooms/no-show confirm were not touched per owner rule.

critical.issue: 500 TypeError when the frontend supplies the string public booking id (e.g. 'MG-69-CF3A95A8-472D-4652-9570-60B642BF85EC') as the {id} path segment. Backend Laravel controller cancelLocalReservation() declares Argument #2 as int. The FE bug is on the legacy page (see frontend BLOCKER below); the backend should also validate/reject or accept the string public id cleanly instead of a 500. Response body confirms: 'App\Http\Controllers\Api\V2\Vendoremployee\AiosellController::cancelLocalReservation(): Argument #2 ($id) must be of type int, string given'.

ui_bugs.issue: BLOCKER — Legacy Cancel action wires setCancelTarget({ reservationId: row.bookingId, ... }). row.bookingId is the *public* string id (e.g. 'MG-69-CF3A95A8-472D-4652-9570-60B642BF85EC'), not the numeric local-reservation id (row.id === 224). CancelBookingDialog then calls cancelReservation(target.reservationId) → POST /aiosell/local-reservations/MG-69-.../cancel → 500. The v2 ArrivalsPanel path is correct (uses row.id). Fix: change `reservationId: row.bookingId` to `reservationId: row.id ?? row.bookingId` (or `row.id`) so the integer id is sent.

integration_issues.issue: Because of the bookingId-vs-id mix-up above, cancel POST returns 500 and the guest card never disappears. A single console error (500 resource) surfaces. No user-visible retry path.

rca of the issue: BLK-C3-LEGACY-ID: CancelBookingDialog expects target.reservationId to be the numeric local-reservation id (used by cancelReservation → POST /api/v2/.../local-reservations/{id}/cancel). The v2 ArrivalsPanel builds the target with `reservationId: row.id` (integer, e.g. 224). The legacy ArrivalsPage builds it with `reservationId: row.bookingId` where bookingId is the public string identifier (e.g. 'MG-69-CF3A95A8-472D-4652-9570-60B642BF85EC'). The POST therefore hits /local-reservations/MG-69-.../cancel, which the Laravel controller rejects with a 500 TypeError (int required). Fix is one line in /app/frontend/src/pages/pms/ArrivalsPage.jsx (onCancel handler): `reservationId: row.id ?? row.bookingId`. Downstream hardening: backend should coerce/validate and return 400/404 instead of leaking a PHP TypeError.
